title: did:webvh credential (draft-atwood-mls-didwebvh-credential-00)
description: Mark 2026-11-16: commits to implementing draft-atwood-mls-didwebvh-credential in mimid, and will say so at the MLS session at IETF 127 (Fri 20 Nov). Spec: ~/PROJECT/mls-didwebvh-credential/draft-atwood-mls-didwebvh-credential.md (-00). The goal is the first implementation, to support the WG question in the draft's Section 7 item 7 (encoding). Build on OpenMLS through the mimi-mls adapter. Credential type 0x0008 and extension type 0x0013 are suggested only, so keep them configurable. Feed what implementing it teaches into -01 (IETF-xgzc in ~/PROJECT/IETF).
